run_loop_eval_improve: run the eval and improve loop to optimize a skill description until all queries pass or max iterations reached
split_eval_set_train_test: split an eval set into stratified train and test sets by should_trigger with a configurable holdout fraction
run_loop_with_holdout: run the skill description optimization loop with train/test split to prevent overfitting on eval queries
generate_live_html_report: generate a live auto-refreshing HTML report showing iteration progress during skill description optimization
save_results_to_directory: save eval results and HTML report to a timestamped output directory with results.json and report.html
